# `cu_method`

[Feature reference](0_home.md)

**Module:** core

**Kind:** node feature

## Description

which alignment mechanisms actually ran on this line, space-separated: zip, damage, compound, numeral. `cu_aligned` cannot say this on its own -- a compound line that also absorbed damage is level 3 and used two mechanisms.
